q: Glorify the name of your Exalted Rabb
v.s: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
v.c: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

q: (the proportions, numbers and capabilities of everything)
(to His creation by guiding them to fulfil the functions for which they were created.)...
v.c: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly,

v.s: And who brings out the pasture

q: reduced it to a black heap of
(This is symbolic of everything of this world, which tempts people to hanker after it but ultimately becomes something useless and unwanted.)
v.c: then reduces it to withered chaff.

v.s: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
v.c: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺,
v.h: The Quran and the Way of Ease

q: (you to forget because it has been) cancelled. See verse 106 of Surah 2).
Verily Allaah knows what is apparent
(and therefore knows best which laws of the Qur'aan to cancel and when).
v.s: Except what God should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
v.c: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden.

q: We shall soon make the easy thing
(so that understanding it, practising it and propagating it becomes easy for you).
v.s: And We will ease you toward ease.
v.c: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease.

q: So advise (remind others to practise the Shari'ah) so that the advice may be beneficial.
(A advice is equally beneficial to the one giving the advice, as it is to others.)
v.s: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
v.c: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺.

v.s: He who fears [God] will be reminded.
v.c: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺.

q: ...whereas only he will turn away from it who is most unfortunate...
v.s: But the wretched one will avoid it
v.c: But it will be shunned by the most wretched,

q: ...and who shall enter the gigantic fire
v.s: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
v.c: who will burn in the greatest Fire,
where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die.

q: Successful indeed is he who has purified
(himself from kufr, shirk and spiritual diseases such as pride, jealousy, etc)...
v.s: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
v.c: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,

q: ...who takes the name of his Rabb
v.s: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
v.c: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.

q: prefer the life of this world...
v.s: But you prefer the worldly life,
v.c: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,

q: ...whereas the Aakhirah is much better and much more lasting.
v.s: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
v.c: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.

v.s: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
v.c: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—

q: the scriptures of Ibraheem ﵊ and Moosa ﵊.
v.s: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
v.c: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
